MC01-SF01.object: Three-view orthographic turnaround sheet of an open timber shopfront bay in a Chinese Song-dynasty style mountain town, about 4 m wide, 4 m deep and 3 m tall, with a three-metre open front veranda, one single unbroken short blank dark indigo cloth valance under the front beam, one tall blank swallow-tailed cloth shop banner hanging from a timber arm beside the post, small hexagonal dark bronze-frame lanterns with blank paper panels hanging from the beam ends, made of aged dark-brown cedar, warm-grey granite and dark bronze joints, showing hand-worn edges, rain streaks and repaired timber joints, no writing. The open veranda stays inside the 4 m footprint and the rear 1 m is a dark closed room with a doorway. Show this one ground-floor module only, ending at its top beam frame: no roof, no upper storey, no stone foundation block, no shelves or merchandise.
